promote.metaDescription: Get listed on Costa de la Luz Guide, the site thousands of travellers use to choose where to stay, eat and go out in Conil, Chiclana, Barbate, Vejer and Zahara de los Atunes.
promote.title: Promote your business on Costa de la Luz Guide
promote.subtitle: Get your own listing —photos, description, contact details and location— on the site travellers use to decide where to stay, eat and go out across the five towns of the Costa de la Luz.
promote.plansSubtitle: Two ways to get listed, depending on what your business needs.
promote.planAnnualDescription: Your listing visible all 12 months of the year, with the option to pay monthly or all at once.
promote.planAnnualBullet1: Full listing with photos, description and contact details
promote.planAnnualBullet2: Visible in search and on your town's page all year round
promote.planAnnualBullet3: Monthly or one-off payment, your choice
promote.planSummerDescription: Your listing visible during high season, from June to September.
promote.planSummerBullet1: Full listing with photos, description and contact details
promote.planSummerBullet2: Visible in search and on your town's page from June to September
